svg.text: Autonomous Ad Campaign Agent — System Design
LangGraph · FastAPI · Next.js · OpenAI · Buffer · ChromaDB · SQLite
reads: episodic · semantic · procedural · entity · conv
All agents read/write shared state · LangGraph manages transitions
All agent I/O slots, task plan, events list
store: in-process RAM · lifetime: one run
LinkedIn / Twitter ad rules, copywriting AIDA
* All agents emit events[] → SSE queue → Frontend AgentFeed
Content Writer → Critic: score dimensions (engagement · brand · compliance · clarity · resonance)
score < 0.80 AND revisions < 3 → loop back to Content Writer with specific feedback
score ≥ 0.80 OR revisions = 3 → force pass → Publisher
revision_count tracked in CampaignState; prevents infinite loops; max_revisions default = 3
